newsitem.title: USA: WR Lazard names Marianne Spraggins chief executive.
newsitem.headline: WR Lazard names Marianne Spraggins chief executive.

text.p: Marianne Spraggins, formerly a managing director in Smith Barney Inc's public finance division, said Friday she was named WR Lazard & Co's chief executive officer.

"The goal is to solidify the operation, which is really fundamentally solid," Spraggins said in an interview. She said her responsibilities will be to oversee day-to-day management and business development.
Spraggins joins the firm more than two years after its founder, Wardell Lazard, was found dead in a Pittsburgh motel room, leaving the future of the minority-owned firm uncertain.
Smith Barney is a unit of Travelers Group Inc.
